title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E07 — The Surprises
Grace hopes to leverage Jack's celebrity connections, and Sol and Robert realize they've met him before; Bud tries to prove he's over Jessica.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E08 — The Short Rib
Grace and Frankie introduce Jack to Nick, hoping they can all go on vacation together; Barry finally gets his short-rib double date.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E09 — The One-at-a-Timing
Frankie enjoys having two men in her life, but Grace warns her about the consequences; Allison and Sol encourage Bud to get a DNA test.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E10 — The Scent
Grace's plan for a relaxing spa day backfires; Frankie tries to find a husband for Joan-Margaret; Robert hosts a fundraiser to save the community theater.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E11 — The Laughing Stock
Grace and Frankie prepare for their pitch, but their prototype has gone missing; Robert keeps a secret from Sol; Brianna receives an offer.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E01 — The Code
When a professional hockey player has a heart attack on the ice, Shade believes the player was sabotaged, so he and Angie investigate.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E02 — Mise En Place
Shade and Angie investigate high-profile murder in a popular Toronto restaurant.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E03 — The Money Shot
Shade and Angie search for a prized racehorse; Shade considers cheating on his P.I. exam.

title: Family Law
description:
S01 E01 — Sins of the Fathers
Abigail begins her probationary period at Svensson and Associates by helping a woman who found her sperm donor via Craigslist sue the father for child support.

title: Family Law
description:
S01 E02 — Parenthood
A couple with Down syndrome is expecting a child; social services has threatened to take the baby away unless they can prove they are capable parents; Abigail and Daniel agree to represent them and try to come up with a workable parenting plan.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E02 — A Beam of Sunshine
Andy makes his intentions known to Jill; Doug is presented with an investment opportunity; Silas helps Nancy with a new business venture; Shane figures out who shot his mother.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E03 — See Blue and Smell Cheese and Die
Nancy and Silas chase after Shane, who has discovered the identity of Nancy's shooter; Andy attempts to bond with Jill's daughters via roller derby; Doug and Whit come up with a new plan.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E04 — Only Judy Can Judge
Nancy plans a family dinner while tending to her pot business; Andy and Jill agree to watch over Stevie; Silas befriends a local pot grower; Doug makes enemies with the neighbor's dog.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E05 — Red in Tooth and Claw
Nancy's attempt to raise money for Stevie's team leads to temptation; Jill uses Doug for revenge; Shane and Angela go on a date.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E06 — Allosaurus Crush Castle
Nancy starts over with a job search; Jill drops a bomb on Andy and Doug; Silas looks for his stolen plants.

title: When Husbands Cheat
description: A woman (Patricia Kalember) becomes a detective, then uses her skills to check her policeman husband's (Tom Irwin) fidelity.

title: Her Best Friend's Husband
description: A woman faces a moral dilemma when she tries to save her friend's marriage but falls in love with the woman's husband.

title: Another Woman's Husband
description: A shared detail threatens to snap the tight bond between two female friends (Lisa Rinna, Gail O'Grady).

title: My Teacher's Wife
description: A high-school student (Jason London) struggling with calculus falls for his tutor (Tia Carrere), who happens to be his math teacher's wife (Christopher McDonald).

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E12 — The Tank
Grace's loyalties are tested as she and Frankie face the Sharks on "Shark Tank;" Robert scrambles to recoup the money he donated; Bud meets his long-lost cousin.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E13 — The Change
Grace tries to make amends to Frankie; Sol gives Robert a taste of his own medicine; Brianna and Barry reach a turning point.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S07 E01 — The Roomies
With their exes living at the beach house and the FBI agents who arrested Nick sniffing around, Grace and Frankie frantically search for the money they hid.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S07 E02 — The Arraignment
While Frankie retrieves the cash, Grace and Nick discuss their marriage at his arraignment; Joan-Margaret hatches a plan for laundering the money.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S07 E03 — The Bunny
Bud tries to soothe discord at the beach house by throwing a brunch for the two families; revelations from the past create even more hard feelings.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E04 — The Devil's Playground
Shade and Angie search for an arsonist and killer in the Toronto Islands; Shade's ego grows with his newly-minted P.I. license.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E05 — The Six
A 14-year-old witness to a shooting must be protected; Shade tries to figure out who Angie spent the night with while trying to keep a promise to his daughter.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E06 — Partners in Crime
Shade and Angie go undercover to try to expose a con artist; Angie, Jules and Don give Shade romantic advice.

title: Family Law
description:
S01 E03 — Addicted to Love
Abigail and Daniel defend Marlee, a mother whose addiction to online gaming has brought her parenting abilities into question; Daniel resolves to tie the knot with Danielle.

title: Family Law
description:
S01 E04 — Mama Don't Preach
Gay teenager Aaron wants to be emancipated from his parents because they are forcing him to attend a Pray Away the Gay camp.; initially skeptical of Aaron's reasons, the lawyers realize how serious the situation is.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E07 — Unfreeze
Nancy and Silas begin new jobs; Shane is put on assignment after graduating from the police academy; Andy looks for work at the local Jewish temple.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E08 — Five Miles From Yetzer Hara
Nancy is promoted and takes on new responsibilities; Silas and Shane start their new jobs, while Doug recruits homeless people in an attempt to legitimize his charity.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E09 — Saplings
Nancy and Silas are approached with a new opportunity, Andy offers up love advice to Rabbi Dave and Doug tries to keep his fake charity from falling apart.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E10 — Threshold
Nancy meets Rabbi Dave's friends during an awkward Shabbos dinner; Andy brings home a very special guest; Silas prepares for his new business venture; Shane and Angela attempt to retrieve some stolen property.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E11 — God Willing and the Creek Don't Rise
Nancy, Andy and Silas take a trip; Shane is busted for stealing property off the impound lot; Doug gives up on his charity.
